question: In a certain code language, if TUBERCULOSIS is written as TSFCBQMVRNTJ, how will INFLUENZA be written in that code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a658dd5648b29497745ea5960c21f566c12e11575f9883797fee22b26638bc5c.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41211f6483743bba4d97f2cd9f1f78436cf9c53b6a3ee2f4db060b3c1e73dbdf.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/172f17e8c2da588db6d2fd1cc4b29b8246157057e8cca37d149dd646f754295a.png] 

As we have seen in the diagram, every two consecutive letters are replaced by the nearest letter of the alphabet according to the pattern. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MHMGDTAOZ"**.
